citation: Skinner (1957) Verbal Behavior: Topography of the Response
rationale: Vocal-verbal responses require the physical manipulation of the vocal cords, which cannot be physically prompted by a technician. Utilizing Full or Partial Physical prompts for vocal targets is a physiological impossibility.

citation: Skinner (1957) Verbal Behavior: Mand Function and Motivation (MO)
rationale: A mand (request) is controlled by a specific motivating operation. If a client is manding for a break or cessation of an activity, the functional reinforcer MUST be the removal of the demand (Break / Escape). Providing a tangible item (like an edible) violates the functional definition of a mand for escape.
If the targeted communication modality relies on an external device or picture exchange system, the corresponding materials must be present in the instructional environment.
